description: This PHP class defines the model for detailed leave request data in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system's API, including serialization logic for API responses and definitions of leave request details, employee info, leave balances, comments, and leave breakdown.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing detailed leave request data into array format for API output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a DetailedLeaveRequest object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the detailed leave request into an associative array suitable for API response.
